Data coverage: full sensor set, 1-minute resolution, 25 Jun 2026 – __DATA_END__ ICT. 25 Jun – 25 Aug 08:59 from the original export; 25 Aug 09:00 onward from the ThingsBoard DRR dashboard (public view). The old ‘alarm’ channel stops on 2 Sep 2026; ThingsBoard now publishes alarm1 and alarm2 (0/1 flags, meaning not yet confirmed) — both are shown here as informational tiles/series and do not change the station status.
unpacking data…
pick a station · every tile below is a live sensor reading with a colored border for its current risk level (green = normal, amber = watch, red = critical, hatched grey = sensor fault excluded by the fault filter) · click any tile to see that one channel's own chart over time, its warning line if it has one, and how it's converted from the raw sensor reading · the site layout under the tiles shows where each sensor physically is — hover/tap a star for its name, or use mark sensors to label your own reference photo
pick a station to see every raw chart for it · use the show toggles to pick which groups are on screen (tilt / soil moisture / rain gauge / weather station — any combination) · drag on a plot to zoom time, drag an axis strip to zoom that scale · double-click an axis to type an exact min/max (dates for the time axis) — a Y range you set stays locked when you change the time range · double-click the plot, press auto in the axis editor, or home to unlock · last 6h / last 24h jump to recent data · settings covers the boundary lines, which warning model is active, its thresholds, the TPM toggle, and the sensor-fault filter (shaded red bands on tilt charts mark spans it has excluded — raw data is never hidden, only the risk scoring skips them) · ← back or Backspace undoes one step · ⌂ home or Home resets everything · shift-drag to pan · click a legend entry to isolate a channel
this page holds the derived views: the Rainfall Envelope (AP-Model, with its own watch/critical fields right on the chart), Tilt Rate (K, degree/hr), and a build-your-own Compare chart (either Y axis: tilt, tilt rate, soil moisture, or rainfall rate, vs time) · measure rate toggle on, then zoom/pan the chart to the window you want — K per channel updates live, sorted by |K| · the Rainfall envelope chart plots 3-day cumulative vs. daily rainfall against the diagonal AP-Model criteria lines, with a from–to date filter and the latest day marked in red · settings and the zoom/pan controls work the same as on the Sensor Readings page
